title: Digital systems
summary: Discover how digital devices work and how different types of data are encoded, stored and organised.

title: Algorithms
summary: Create and apply step-by-step algorithms to solve problems, find errors, debug solutions and test that they work.

title: Programming
summary: Use programming tools and computational thinking to create purposeful programs, then test and improve them.

title: Data
summary: Use digital tools and data to solve problems. Collect information, organise it in spreadsheets and graphs, and identify patterns.

title: Digital citizenship
summary: Make safe, thoughtful digital choices by considering security, reliability, accuracy, usability and bias, and evaluating misinformation, AI suitability and ethical impacts.

title: Systems and control
summary: Explore mechanical, electrical, electronic and digital systems. Use circuit symbols, build simple circuits and investigate subsystems, feedback, input-process-output relationships and combined systems.

title: Design and innovation
summary: Model ideas, choose suitable methods and develop specifications. Test solutions through systematic trials, then refine and improve your outcomes.
